title: Greek Connections Study
official: Increasing Availability of and Engagement in Alcohol-Free Social Activities to Address Heavy Episodic Drinking and Alcohol Consequences Among Fraternity and Sorority College Students
summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the feasibility and acceptability of an intervention aiming to reduce heavy episodic drinking and negative consequences from alcohol by increasing the availability of and engagement in alcohol-free social activities for college students who are affiliated with a fraternity or sorority organization.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Active membership in a sorority or fraternity organization at the University of Washington
* Age 18-29 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* None beyond failure to meet the inclusion criteria.

sites.f: University of Washington School of Medicine
